items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: It was Groshearts where Joe Aller was playing. ... Let's go by Joe's.

ctx.x: Drip the blood. Boy, Brooks, flowers, you know. He's the one when his wife started off, he killed Billy Phillip. And the other Charlie, they were shot, injured. And Drip the blood, he was shot. He ran through the hall, ran across the street. We happened to get off the bandstand. I didn't want to, I take the rope. I said, well, I'm going to tie this rope to the piano. He says, tie it to the piano. Tie it any way. And come on down the rope. There was Peter. Oh man, look at the contract. He was praying, saying his…
And you go right out to Liberty Street, right opposite the corner there. It was Groshearts where Joe Aller was playing.

So, see the people running over that way. Let's go by Joe's. that way. Let's go by Joe's. We went by Joe's, I'll see the excitement there, was a drip of blood. He had ran, shot, and he went and fell in that place, in Groeschel's. Fell down, laying on the floor. Pick him up, brought him down the last. Well, he got over it, yeah.
